uncertainties.issue: Marker timing: source spreads 3 markers over "no soutou" (sweep of); English fires them together after "targets". On-screen timing not verifiable without a build.
Source splits markers inside the two-kanji words (kyoten, butai); English puts them before/after the whole word so no word is broken by a tag. Order unchanged.
<move(2,6,10)> does not match the earlier <move(1,7,11)> coordinates in the source; copied as is.

checked_decisions: Slot 0 "New Federation" = enemy faction label, orchestrator spelling.

Slot 20 ruling: three type-22 markers fired together after "targets" - order identical to source, only timing differs; acceptable, needs an on-screen look. <move(1,7,9)> starts the radar sentence as in the source.
Slot 21 ruling: moving markers to word boundaries instead of between the two kanji of kyoten/butai is correct practice; command order identical.
Slot 22 ruling: <move(2,6,10)> not matching <move(1,7,11)> is source data; copied unchanged, correct.
Slot 22: "Gekko" = the ship, matches glossary.json. Slot 23: "ref boards" and "KLF" match encyclopedia_022.
remaining_uncertainties: Slots 20-21: marker timing relative to the English words can only be verified in a build.
